verdict.rationale: Sentry documents that you can run all of Sentry on your own server from public source. Community reports confirm years of production self-hosting with mostly workable upgrades (about 90% smooth; one break at the 9-to-date-versioning jump). However, Sentry itself frames the offering as a minimal setup for simple use cases with no guarantees or dedicated support, and the pack contains no first-party architecture or upgrade-path documentation. Missing for 10: first-party documented architecture, a documented upgrade path or procedure, production-grade support guarantees, and scaling guidance (community had to tune Kafka/Redis themselves).

support.subject: As an SRE, I can run the full observability stack self-hosted in production with documented architecture and upgrade path

citations.quote: How you can run all of Sentry on your own server, without paying anything.
Sentry offers and maintains a minimal setup that works out-of-the-box for simple use cases. This version comes with no guarantees or dedicated support.
In addition to making its source code available publicly, Sentry offers and maintains a minimal setup that works out-of-the-box for simple use cases.
